context.why: First story of the feature. Today /api/v1/contributors/ serves people and organizations through one ContributorSerializer, and a record's `contributors` list holds credits of three fields (two references and roles). This story rewrites the credit so it carries what DataCite asks of a creator, replaces the mixed endpoint with /api/v1/people/ and /api/v1/organizations/ serving their LIST shape for both the list and the single record (stories 2 and 3 add the fuller single-record serializers, filters and their documentation), points every reference at the typed routes, and deletes the old endpoint and serializer. About twenty existing tests name the routes api:contributor-list and api:contributor-detail: T004 moves each to the new routes keeping what it asserts. One existing test, TestReferencesFollowTheLists.test_a_credit_to_that_contributor_reads_null, is REPLACED by T002 because the specification now asks for the opposite.
spec_sections: User Story 2 scenarios 1-3 and 11, User Story 3 scenarios 1-3 (the list entries only)
Edge Cases (old address answered as not existing, deleted contributor, deleted affiliation organization, identifier with no resolver)
plan_sections: D1. A credit mirrors a DataCite creator
D2. People (the list serializer and the viewset only; no PersonSerializer, no filters yet)
D3. Organizations (the list serializer and the viewset only)
prior_decisions: decisions.md D5: a credit held by an account the people list leaves out (a superuser, the anonymous account) is still returned with name, name_identifiers and roles, and with uuid and url null. The set of hidden accounts is FairDMVisibilityFilter.hidden_contributors(); RecordReferenceField.visible_pks() already loads it once per request into the serializer context under 'hidden_contributors' and the credit serializer should read it the same way, not query per credit.

decisions.md D12: given and family name on a credit come from an annotation on the credit queryset in RecordSerializer.load_related(), through contributor__person__first_name and contributor__person__last_name, in the same query. A credit serialized without the annotation (the body answering a create or an update, where DRF has emptied the prefetch cache) reads the names from the contributor's real instance. name_type and the typed route come from get_real_instance_class(), which needs no query.

The credit's `name` for a person is Person.get_full_name_display('family_given') semantics: 'Family, Given' with both names, the one name when only one is set, the contributor's `name` when neither is. With the annotation you have only the two strings and the base contributor's name, so build the same result from them. For an organization it is `name`.

name_identifiers entries: `name_identifier` is the identifier's resolver address where the scheme has one (ContributorIdentifier.resolver_url) and the bare value otherwise; `name_identifier_scheme` is the identifier's type; `scheme_uri` is ContributorIdentifier.get_root_url() or null when the type has none (IdentifierLookup.get returns None).

`affiliation` on a credit is a LIST with no entry or one, built from Contribution.affiliation only, never from the person's profile. Its entry: uuid, url, name, affiliation_identifier, affiliation_identifier_scheme, scheme_uri, taking the organization's ROR identifier where it has one and otherwise its first, and null for the three identifier keys when it has none.

decisions.md D10 and D11: PersonListSerializer returns exactly url, html_url, uuid, name, given_name, family_name, identifiers, primary_organization. OrganizationListSerializer returns exactly url, html_url, uuid, name, type, country, identifiers, with type and country as stored codes. Neither returns added or modified; both stay in the viewsets' ordering_fields.

Design review SEC-001: a person's primary_organization is the organization of the primary entry in Person.get_affiliation_history()['current'], which is verified and not ended. Do NOT read Person.primary_organization or primary_affiliation(): they return a pending or ended affiliation too. It is {uuid, url, name} from OrganizationReferenceSerializer, or null.

PersonViewSet's queryset is Person.objects.real() (it leaves out superusers and the anonymous account), prefetching identifiers and affiliations__organization. OrganizationViewSet's is Organization.objects.all() prefetching identifiers. Both: ReadOnlyModelViewSet, lookup_field uuid, AllowAny, grouped under their own heading (CORE_HEADINGS gains people and organizations and loses contributors). Check fairdm/api/permissions.py for how the object permission treats a model with no visibility rule; the old ContributorViewSet is the working example.

RecordReferenceField.route_name() must return api:person-detail or api:organization-detail from the real class without a query. Project.owner (an Organization) is such a reference and must keep working.
fairdm/contrib/contributors/plugins/overview.py line 117 builds a profile page's API address from api:contributor-detail; build it from the contributor's real type.

T007 documentation: docs/portal-development/restful-api.md has the endpoint table (lines ~32), the credit shape (~55-62, ~107), a Contributors section (~225-241), a serializer reference table (~577-584) and the documentation headings (~812-865). In this story: correct the endpoint table, rewrite the credit shape with a table mapping each credit field to its DataCite property, correct the hidden-account sentence, replace the Contributors section with short People and Organizations sections describing the list entry only (stories 2 and 3 extend them), and correct the reference table and headings. docs/user-guide/reading-records-with-a-script.md line ~149. specs/011-restful-api/spec.md: edit every statement about the contributors endpoint and the shape of a credit to read as the API now behaves, as current state with no dated note and no strikethrough; leave the other files in specs/011-restful-api/ untouched.

The verify docs step is red when a public name has no page quoting it and when a page documents something the branch changed and never touched. Every new public class this story adds must be named in docs/portal-development/restful-api.md.
